title: Converting free signs to bits
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $P\subseteq[n]$, and let $y$ assign a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each coordinate in $[n]\setminus P$. Assign to each such coordinate its corresponding bit under the inverse of the standard bijection between $\mathbb F_2$ and $\{-1,1\}$, obtaining a bit assignment on $[n]\setminus P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a set of coordinates in $[n]$
